purpose: Designs target fixing, ID checking, DLID assignment and ToC building: argument rules, target expansion, change set detection, candidate commit, completion output and write units.
summary: Inputs and outputs of the build; the completion result returns only items and counts to stdout while full details go to a detail file
Target fixing: argument combination rules, directory and pattern expansion, exclusion matching, fixed excluded names, path normalization, Markdown detection and symlink handling
ID check excludes documents without IDs or with duplicates and continues the build; an unreadable document stops it
DLID assignment operation: explicit invocation, duplicate original confirmation by the user, new ID issuance, section ID writing, count-only reporting, and rollback of non-DLID diffs
Change set: new, left target, path change, content hash change, reference or physical path change, plus section-level add, delete, move, heading change and body change by section ID
Move detection records previous and new paths per key in a temporary record file used to build the final result
Update plan reuses existing generated information, and the AI generates only for new or changed documents with script validation
Candidate validation and atomic publication of the confirmed ToC; document information is committed per document
Completion output fields and the detail file with full change sets, generated documents and reference findings
Write units use os.replace with no locks; reruns converge after failure
tasks: Implementing index-docs or the target spec expansion
Implementing change detection and section-level diff
Designing build completion output and detail files
Handling build failure and rerun behavior
Writing tests for target specification and exclusion rules
Reviewing ToC candidate commit and write atomicity
title: DES-005 対象確定・DLID 付与・[ToC]構築設計
